newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Telstra in global telecommunications talks.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Telstra in global telecommunications talks.

text.p: Australian telecoms group Telstra Corp AOT.AX said on Friday it had been in talks with British Telecom, MCI Communications Corp, AT&T Corp and the Global One consortium about possible alliances.
"We are dancing with everyone at the moment but we haven't taken any one home from the dance yet," Telstra chief executive officer Frank Blount told a news conference.
"We have had talks with Global One...we have had talks with AT&T...and we have continuing talks with BT/MCI," Blount said.
Global One is a telecommunications venture owned by U.S. carrier Sprint Corp, Deutsche Telecom Ag and France Telecom.

Telstra already has a joint venture with International Buisness Machines Corp to provide telecommunications services to the Asia Pacific region and has the Foxtel pay television venture with News Corp Ltd.

Telstra said in a statement accompanying its six months results to December 31 that it was pursimg talks with telecommunications, information and technology groups with a view to forming global alliances or joint ventures.
Telstra's net profit before abormals rose 16.1 percent to A$1.4 billion, while net profit after abnormals fell to A$742 million from A$1.205 billion.
